cohort: Women with polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) undergoing frozen embryo transfer cycles
finding: The letrozole-stimulated (LS) protocol was associated with a higher clinical pregnancy rate, live birth rate, and a lower risk of miscarriage, hypertensive disorders of pregnancy, and gestational diabetes mellitus compared to the hormone replacement treatment (HRT) protocol in women with PCOS undergoing frozen embryo transfer.
